journey.name: Discover — global browse, topics, people, add friend
journey.description:
Discover with ZERO follows is the point of this journey (#26): a brand-new account must see real decks and real people without knowing anyone's pubky. Everything below the header comes from the Nexus indexer, so it needs a signed-in session (journey 01) and at least one deck published network-wide with a topical tag — journey 02 produces exactly that.
If the indexer has not ingested anything yet, the browse strip shows "Nothing published here yet" with an Add-a-friend CTA. That is a pass for the empty case, not a failure: verify the honest empty state rather than skipping the journey. Confirm which case you are in with `curl 'https://nexus.staging.pubky.app/v0/stream/resources?app=loopky&tags=loopky-deck&limit=5'` before starting.

actions.action: Launch the Loopky app and verify the Home screen is shown
Tap the element with resource-id "tab_discover" in the bottom tab bar
Verify the Discover screen is shown (resource-id: discover_screen) with an "Add friend" button (resource-id: discover_add_friend)
Verify a "Browse decks" section is present — this is the global browse, and it must NOT require following anyone

Wait for the browse strip to settle, then verify EITHER at least one deck tile (resource-id: discover_deck_tile) OR the empty block (resource-id: discover_browse_empty) reading "Nothing published here yet" with an "Add a friend" button. There must never be a bare "Follow a friend to see their decks here" dead end.
If a topic chip row is visible (resource-id: discover_topic_row), tap the first chip (resource-id: discover_topic_chip)

Verify the browse heading changes to "Decks tagged “…”" and a "Clear" control appears (resource-id: discover_clear_tag). The deck list is re-queried from the indexer, so it may legitimately differ from the unfiltered list.
Tap the element with resource-id "discover_clear_tag" and verify the heading returns to "Browse decks"
If a "People on Loopky" strip is visible (resource-id: discover_people_row), tap the Follow pill on the first person (resource-id: discover_follow) and verify it flips to "Following" immediately
Pull to refresh and verify the followed person no longer appears in the People strip — suggestions exclude people you already follow
Note: the People strip is legitimately absent when the only published decks are your own, since suggestions exclude yourself. That is a pass.

Verify a bottom sheet appears with a "Paste a pubky or pubky:// link" input (resource-id: add_friend_input), a "Scan QR" button (resource-id: add_friend_scan) and an "Open" button (resource-id: add_friend_open) — these ids only surface because the sheet sets its own testTagsAsResourceId
Type your OWN pubky into the field with resource-id "add_friend_input" and tap the element with resource-id "add_friend_open"
Verify your own profile is shown with NO Follow button (regression: you could follow yourself)

Turn the device radios off, pull to refresh, and verify the screen still renders: the "From people you follow" section shows an error with a working Retry, while the other strips show their own empty states. The screen must never go blank.
Turn the radios back on and pull to refresh to confirm recovery
